name: Umami Self-Hosted
description: Umami Self-Hosted is the customer-operated edition of Umami's open-source, privacy-focused web and product analytics platform. Teams use it to measure aggregate traffic, content performance and live activity while retaining control of the application and analytics database.
agentUseSummary: Connect one current public HTTPS Umami installation with a dedicated least-privilege username and password plus one exact website UUID. Selected agents can read four fixed bounded aggregate reports under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions; tracking, administration, raw events, sessions, arbitrary filters and private-network endpoints remain unavailable.

credentialRequirements.name: UMAMI_SELF_HOSTED_INSTALLATION_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Umami installation URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: The public HTTPS root of one current customer-operated Umami installation. Private addresses, custom ports, redirects and embedded credentials are rejected.

credentialRequirements.name: UMAMI_SELF_HOSTED_USERNAME
credentialRequirements.label: Umami username
credentialRequirements.helpText: A dedicated least-privilege Umami user that can view only the intended website.

credentialRequirements.name: UMAMI_SELF_HOSTED_PASSWORD
credentialRequirements.label: Umami password
credentialRequirements.helpText: The dedicated user's password. Relay sends it only to the exact installation's fixed login endpoint and never logs it or the returned bearer token.

credentialRequirements.name: UMAMI_SELF_HOSTED_WEBSITE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Umami website ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact UUID of the intended Umami website.

capabilities.label: Traffic overview
capabilities.description: Read aggregate website totals and a bounded pageview/session time series for one exact website.

capabilities.label: Content performance
capabilities.description: Read bounded aggregate top-page paths with query strings removed.

capabilities.label: Aggregate active visitors
capabilities.description: Read only the current aggregate active-visitor count.

approvalRequired.label: Read website statistics
approvalRequired.description: Read fixed aggregate pageview, visitor, visit, bounce and time totals.

approvalRequired.label: Read top pages
approvalRequired.description: Read at most twenty aggregate page-path rows with query strings stripped.

approvalRequired.label: Read pageview series
approvalRequired.description: Read a bounded UTC pageview and session time series for one recent window.

approvalRequired.label: Read active visitors
approvalRequired.description: Read the aggregate number of visitors active in the last five minutes.

blocked.label: Send events
blocked.description: Tracking, identify, performance, custom-event and historical event injection calls are unavailable.

blocked.label: Manage sites
blocked.description: Website provisioning, settings, reset, shared links, users, teams and account administration are unavailable.

blocked.label: Read raw data
blocked.description: PostgreSQL, raw events, sessions, event data, distinct IDs and visitor-level records are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run raw stats queries
blocked.description: Agents cannot choose metric types, filters, segments, timestamps, timezones, offsets, website IDs, URLs or arbitrary requests.

blocked.label: Reach private infrastructure
blocked.description: Private, local, reserved, link-local, non-HTTPS and redirecting endpoints are unavailable; Relay opens no tunnel and keeps the web backend on Railway.

blocked.label: Export unbounded analytics
blocked.description: Five fixed recent windows, twenty-row tables and 256 KiB responses are the maximum supported surface.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All private analytics reads require approval. Exact installation and website binding, fixed API queries, bounds and audits always apply.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All four aggregate reads run without Relay per-action approval; exact authority, fixed queries, bounds, redaction and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway authenticates at one exact public HTTPS Umami installation and executes four fixed aggregate reads for one exact website UUID with SSRF protection, bounds and redaction.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer operates and secures a current Umami release at a public HTTPS URL, creates a dedicated least-privilege user with access only to the intended website, confirms its UUID, and enters those values in Relay. Keep Umami and PostgreSQL patched, backed up and isolated; never expose PostgreSQL publicly.

evidence.supports: Umami is an MIT-licensed open-source, privacy-focused analytics platform that can be self-hosted with PostgreSQL.
The current Umami v3 documentation describes core aggregate web analytics including pageviews, visitors, engagement, referrers, devices and countries.
The official API overview states that self-hosted endpoints live under the installation's /api path and require authentication.
The official reporting guide documents POST /api/auth/login with username/password, the returned Bearer token and self-hosted website statistics requests.
The official website statistics reference documents fixed stats, pageviews, metrics and active visitor GET endpoints plus their timestamp, unit, type and limit parameters.
